hypotheses.U0_two_disjoint_panels_are_used: Discovery and replication use nonoverlapping FineWeb row ranges with identical sampling and no decoded strings during candidate selection.
hypotheses.U1_discrete_route_coalitions_replicate: At least eight layers have mean matched four-center cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.U2_recurrence_beats_destroyed_head_bindi: Mean matched-center cosine across layers exceeds the 95th percentile of per-edge head-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.U3_stable_candidates_exist: At least twelve layer-local coalitions pass center-cosine, size, and within-cluster-coherence gates.
hypotheses.U4_stable_candidates_are_not_only_single: At least half of the selected candidates have center effective support at least two heads.
